name: Democratic Republic of the Congo (state)
description: Congolese state. Use a sub-entity whenever the force actually holding the place is known.

name: Forces Armées de la République Démocratique du Congo
description: Army. Controller where the army is the main permanent force (garrison towns, operation zones, mining sites it runs).

name: Police Nationale Congolaise
description: National police. Default controller of state-held towns and neighbourhoods where order is kept by police posts/commissariats.

name: Garde Républicaine
description: Presidential guard; controller only where it is the main permanent force (e.g. presidential areas of Kinshasa).

name: Wazalendo / Volontaires pour la Défense de la Patrie (VDP)
description: Umbrella of pro-government armed groups (mostly ex Mai-Mai/Nyatura) legalised as reservists in 2023. Use it only when the specific group is unknown; individual groups that act autonomously are separate top-level entities.

name: Alliance Fleuve Congo / Mouvement du 23 Mars
description: Rebel movement administering parts of Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu (Goma, Bukavu since early 2025) with its own administration, police and army.

name: Force de Défense Nationale du Burundi
Allied Democratic Forces / ISCAP
description: Islamic State Central Africa Province affiliate active in Beni, Lubero (Nord-Kivu) and Irumu, Mambasa (Ituri).

name: Coopérative pour le Développement du Congo (CODECO) factions
description: Lendu-based militias, Djugu and Mahagi (Ituri).

name: Convention pour la Révolution Populaire / Zaïre
description: Hema-based self-defence militia in Djugu (Ituri); CRP led by Thomas Lubanga (allied to AFC/M23).

name: Front Patriotique et Intégrationniste du Congo
Force de Résistance Patriotique de l'Ituri
Forces Démocratiques de Libération du Rwanda
Alliance des Patriotes pour un Congo Libre et Souverain
Mai-Mai Mazembe / UPLC and related Lubero militias
Coalition Nationale du Peuple pour la Souveraineté du Congo (Mai-Mai Yakutumba)
Twirwaneho
description: Banyamulenge self-defence group, Hauts Plateaux of Sud-Kivu; allied with AFC/M23 since 2025.

name: Mobondo militia
description: Yaka/Suku-based militia active in Kwamouth (Maï-Ndombe), Kwango, Kwilu and Kinshasa outskirts since 2022.

name: Kuluna gangs
description: Urban gangs (Kinshasa and other cities).

name: Customary authority (chief's guards) without state force
Institut Congolais pour la Conservation de la Nature (ICCN) eco-guards
description: Armed park rangers of the state conservation agency; controller only at park headquarters/stations and inside protected areas.

name: Mai-Mai Simba (Mambasa/Bafwasende)
description: Fragmented Mai-Mai Simba groups (successors of Paul Sadala 'Morgan' and 'Manu'/Lumumba factions) engaged in poaching, illegal gold mining and raids in and around the Okapi Wildlife Reserve and Maiko park (Mambasa, Bafwasende).
Lord's Resistance Army - Ugandan-origin rebel group whose remnants raid and abduct in Bas-Uele/Haut-Uele from bases in CAR.
name: Lord's Resistance Army (LRA)

description: Ex-Seleka Central African armed factions (e.g. UPC elements) making cross-border incursions into Bas-Uele.
name: Ex-Seleka CAR armed factions
Armed Mbororo herders
description: Armed transhumant Mbororo (Fulani) cattle herders in the Uele provinces, accused of killings, kidnappings and crop destruction; no fixed territorial control.

name: SPLA-IO (Sudan People's Liberation Army in Opposition)
description: South Sudanese armed opposition (Riek Machar's SPLM-IO); elements from Central Equatoria cross into Aru/Faradje (DRC) for looting and abductions; called 'AIO' locally.

name: South Sudan People's Defence Forces
description: National army of South Sudan; soldiers reported making cross-border incursions into Aru territory (Ituri) in 2025-2026.

name: Mouvement Débout Katanga pour la Libération du Congo (MDKC)
description: Katangese separatist armed movement that surfaced in March 2026 claiming the capture of Lusinga (Upemba NP, Mitwaba); overlaps with Bakata Katanga Mai-Mai networks; no confirmed durable territorial control.

name: Service National (RDC)
description: Paramilitary national service under the presidency that runs civic/re-education training centres and agricultural domains (notably Kaniama-Kasese); controller only at its own sites.
